_doc: Redacted findings register for P7-prep (2026-09-21). This file MUST NOT contain raw secrets, credentials, or live API keys. Every finding carries a stable id, the affected revision, a reproducer path or stub, exploitability, ownership and state. Companion summary: backend/security/findings.md.

findings.title: CAP transport lacks redirect guard
findings.rationale_redacted: follows Go default redirects in absence of CheckRedirect; relies on deployment wiring

findings.title: Outbound HTTP egress not allowlisted
findings.rationale_redacted: central egress allowlist is a deployment-time control; not in scope of code-only review

findings.title: Middle-model prompt guard layering
findings.reproducer: see Worker 5 fuzz harness + integration adversarial coverage P9 (gated by O15)
findings.rationale_redacted: model is non-deterministic; control is the type system + independent validator

findings.title: Session leakage in logs (negative finding)
findings.rationale_redacted: current RequestLogger redacts Authorization / Cookie / X-Forwarded-*

findings.title: Bearer header parsing strictness (informational)
findings.rationale_redacted: strict HasPrefix; trim only the right

findings.title: Audit chain reach (negative finding)

delivery_notes: Per the task brief, this is P7 *preparation*. No final security certificate is granted and no Gate B pass is signaled by this directory.
Scanner absences are reported as NOT_EVALUATED, never as 0/0/0. Installing the pinned tools is the team's choice at P7 body.
Reproducer paths reference narrowly assigned security test files written alongside this directory. They follow the *security_test.go naming; they live in the same package as the code they exercise.
